license_required.quote: any person who practices or offers to practice nursing in this State shall submit evidence that he or she is qualified to practice and must be licensed as provided in this chapter

issuing_authority.quote: The Board shall issue a license to practice nursing as a professional nurse in the State of Nevada to each applicant who successfully passes such examination or examinations.

name.quote: The Board shall issue a license to practice nursing as a professional nurse in the State of Nevada to each applicant who successfully passes such examination or examinations.

type.quote: The Board shall: (a) Adopt regulations establishing reasonable standards ... (b) Prepare and administer examinations for the issuance of a license or certificate under this chapter.

age_minimum.quote: Is at least 18 years of age.

degree_required.value: Diploma from accredited or approved school of professional nursing
degree_required.quote: Has completed a course of study in: (1) An accredited school of professional nursing and holds a diploma therefrom; or (2) An approved school of professional nursing in the process of obtaining accreditation and holds a diploma therefrom.

accrediting_body.value: Nationally recognized association or agency authorized by law to accredit schools of nursing
accrediting_body.quote: a school of nursing which is accredited by a nationally recognized association or an agency authorized by law to accredit schools of nursing in the state in which the school is located

exams.name: Professional Nurse Licensing Examination
exams.notes: Written examination; may be supplemented by oral or practical examination at Board's discretion
exams.quote: each applicant who is otherwise qualified for a license to practice nursing as a professional nurse shall be required to write and pass an examination on such subjects and in such form as the Board may from time to time determine

exams.name: Practical Nurse Licensing Examination
exams.notes: Given by the Board not less than once each calendar year
exams.quote: Passes the practical nurses examination, which examination must be given by the Board not less than once each calendar year

interval_years.quote: Every nurse licensed under the provisions of this chapter must renew his or her license biennially on a date or according to a schedule of dates prescribed by regulation of the Board.

required.quote: The Board shall not renew any license issued under this chapter until the licensee has submitted proof satisfactory to the Board of completion, during the 2-year period before renewal of the license, of 30 hours in a program of continuing education approved by the Board

hours_per_period.quote: completion, during the 2-year period before renewal of the license, of 30 hours in a program of continuing education approved by the Board

period_years.quote: during the 2-year period before renewal of the license, of 30 hours in a program of continuing education

value: At least 4 hours on medical consequences of acts of terrorism involving weapons of mass destruction (within 2 years of initial licensure)
At least 4 hours on cultural competency and diversity, equity and inclusion (biennially)
For APRNs: at least 2 hours on suicide prevention and awareness (within 2 years of initial licensure, then every 4 years)
For APRNs: at least 2 hours on screening, brief intervention and referral to treatment approach to substance use disorder (within 2 years of initial licensure)
For APRNs registered to dispense controlled substances: at least 2 hours on substance use/addictive disorders and prescribing of opioids per licensure period
For nurses providing/supervising emergency medical services in hospital or primary care: at least 2 hours on stigma/discrimination/bias toward persons with or at risk of HIV
topical_requirements.quote: The program of continuing education required by subsection 1 must include: (a) For a person licensed as an advanced practice registered nurse ... (b) For each person licensed pursuant to this chapter, a course of instruction ... relating to the medical consequences of an act of terrorism ... (c) For each person licensed pursuant to this chapter, one or more courses of instruction that provide at least 4 hours of instruction relating to cultural competency and diversity, equity and inclusion

available.quote: The Board shall, without examination, issue a license to practice nursing as a professional nurse to any applicant who otherwise meets the qualifications required of professional nurses in this State and who has been duly licensed or registered as a registered nurse under the laws of any other jurisdiction after passing an examination required by that jurisdiction

requirements.value: Applicant must meet Nevada qualifications and have passed an equivalent examination in another jurisdiction. If trained in a non-English-speaking jurisdiction, must pass English proficiency exam. Expedited endorsement available for those holding valid unrestricted licenses in other US jurisdictions.
requirements.quote: if it appears to the Board that the requirements and scope of the required examination were at least equivalent to those prescribed by this chapter for examinations

regulatory_model.quote: any person who practices or offers to practice nursing in this State shall submit evidence that he or she is qualified to practice and must be licensed as provided in this chapter

credential_type.quote: The Board shall issue a license to practice nursing as a professional nurse in the State of Nevada to each applicant who successfully passes such examination or examinations.

is_mandatory.quote: It is unlawful for any person: (a) To practice or offer to practice nursing in this State or use any title, abbreviation, sign, card or device to indicate that he or she is practicing nursing in this State unless that person has been licensed pursuant to the provisions of this chapter

title_protection.quote: Who does not hold a valid and subsisting license to practice nursing issued pursuant to the provisions of this chapter to practice or offer to practice in this State as a registered nurse, licensed practical nurse, graduate nurse, trained nurse, certified nurse or under any other title or designation suggesting that the person possesses qualifications and skill in the field of nursing.

scope_protection.quote: It is unlawful for any person: (a) To practice or offer to practice nursing in this State or use any title, abbreviation, sign, card or device to indicate that he or she is practicing nursing in this State unless that person has been licensed pursuant to the provisions of this chapter

disciplinary_grounds.description: Fraud or deceit in procuring or attempting to procure a license or certificate
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Is guilty of fraud or deceit in procuring or attempting to procure a license or certificate pursuant to this chapter.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Conviction of any offense involving moral turpitude or related to the qualifications, functions or duties of a licensee
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Is guilty of any offense: (1) Involving moral turpitude; or (2) Related to the qualifications, functions or duties of a licensee or holder of a certificate, in which case the record of conviction is conclusive evidence thereof.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Conviction of violating workers' compensation fraud provisions
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has been convicted of violating any of the provisions of NRS 616D.200, 616D.220, 616D.240 or 616D.300 to 616D.440, inclusive.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Unfitness or incompetence by reason of gross negligence or recklessness in carrying out usual nursing functions
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Is unfit or incompetent by reason of gross negligence or recklessness in carrying out usual nursing functions.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Use of controlled substance, dangerous drug, or intoxicating liquor in a manner dangerous to others or impairing ability to practice
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Uses any controlled substance, dangerous drug as defined in chapter 454 of NRS, or intoxicating liquor to an extent or in a manner which is dangerous or injurious to any other person or which impairs his or her ability to conduct the practice authorized by the license or certificate.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Being a person with mental incompetence
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Is a person with mental incompetence.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Unprofessional conduct including impersonation, permitting license misuse, repeated malpractice, patient abuse, or controlled substance conviction
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Is guilty of unprofessional conduct, which includes, but is not limited to, the following: (1) Conviction of practicing medicine without a license ... (2) Impersonating any applicant ... (5) Repeated malpractice ... (6) Physical, verbal or psychological abuse of a patient.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Willfully or repeatedly violating the provisions of this chapter
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has willfully or repeatedly violated the provisions of this chapter. The voluntary surrender of a license or certificate issued pursuant to this chapter is prima facie evidence that the licensee or certificate holder has committed or expects to commit a violation of this chapter.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Aiding or abetting any person in a violation of this chapter
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Is guilty of aiding or abetting any person in a violation of this chapter.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Falsifying an entry on a patient's medical chart concerning a controlled substance
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has falsified an entry on a patient's medical chart concerning a controlled substance.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Falsifying information given to a physician, pharmacist, podiatric physician or dentist to obtain a controlled substance
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has falsified information which was given to a physician, pharmacist, podiatric physician or dentist to obtain a controlled substance.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Knowingly procuring or administering a controlled substance or dangerous drug not approved by the FDA (with limited exceptions)
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has knowingly procured or administered a controlled substance or a dangerous drug as defined in chapter 454 of NRS that is not approved by the United States Food and Drug Administration

disciplinary_grounds.description: Disciplined in another state in connection with a nursing license or certificate, or committed an act in another state that would constitute a violation of this chapter
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has been disciplined in another state in connection with a license to practice nursing or a certificate to practice as a nursing assistant or medication aide - certified, or has committed an act in another state which would constitute a violation of this chapter.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Engaging in conduct likely to deceive, defraud or endanger a patient or the general public
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has engaged in conduct likely to deceive, defraud or endanger a patient or the general public.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Willfully failing to comply with a regulation, subpoena or order of the Board
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has willfully failed to comply with a regulation, subpoena or order of the Board.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Operating a medical facility during a period when its license was suspended or revoked
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has operated a medical facility at any time during which: (1) The license of the facility was suspended or revoked; or (2) An act or omission occurred which resulted in the suspension or revocation of the license pursuant to NRS 449.160.

disciplinary_grounds.description: APRN failing to obtain training required by the Board regarding substance use disorders and opioid prescribing
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Is an advanced practice registered nurse who has failed to obtain any training required by the Board pursuant to NRS 632.2375.

disciplinary_grounds.description: APRN failing to comply with controlled substance prescribing statutes and pharmacy board regulations
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Is an advanced practice registered nurse who has failed to comply with the provisions of NRS 453.163, 453.164, 453.226, 639.23507, 639.23535 and 639.2391 to 639.23916, inclusive, and any regulations adopted by the State Board of Pharmacy pursuant thereto.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Fraudulent, illegal, unauthorized or otherwise inappropriate prescribing, administering or dispensing of a schedule II, III or IV controlled substance
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has engaged in the fraudulent, illegal, unauthorized or otherwise inappropriate prescribing, administering or dispensing of a controlled substance listed in schedule II, III or IV.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violating provisions related to safe injection practices or dermal/soft tissue fillers
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has violated the provisions of NRS 454.217 or 629.086.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Performing or supervising a pelvic examination in violation of NRS 629.085
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has performed or supervised the performance of a pelvic examination in violation of NRS 629.085.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failing to comply with communicable disease reporting provisions
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has failed to comply with the provisions of NRS 441A.315 or any regulations adopted pursuant thereto.

definition_quote.value: The practice of nursing means the general observation, diagnosis and treatment of changes in a person's health. The term does not include acts of medical diagnosis or prescription of therapeutic or corrective measures, except as authorized by specific statute.
definition_quote.quote: "Practice of nursing" means the general observation, diagnosis and treatment of changes in a person's health. The term does not include acts of medical diagnosis or prescription of therapeutic or corrective measures, except as authorized by specific statute.

value: observation, care and counsel of the ill, injured or infirm
maintenance of health or prevention of illness
supervision and teaching of other personnel
administration of medications and treatments as prescribed by authorized practitioners
selected acts in the care of the ill, injured or infirm (practical nursing, under direction)
acts under emergency or special conditions recognized by medical and nursing professions
methods_authorized.quote: "Practice of professional nursing" means the performance of any act in the observation, care and counsel of the ill, injured or infirm, in the maintenance of health or prevention of illness of others, in the supervision and teaching of other personnel, in the administration of medications and treatments as prescribed by an advanced practice registered nurse, a licensed physician, a physician assistant licensed pursuant to chapter 630 or 633 of NRS, a licensed dentist or a licensed podiatric physician

drug_authority.value: Professional nurses administer medications and treatments as prescribed by authorized practitioners. APRNs may prescribe controlled substances, poisons, dangerous drugs and devices if authorized pursuant to NRS 639.2351, subject to limitations. CRNAs may order, prescribe, possess and administer controlled substances in critical access hospitals under physician supervision.
drug_authority.quote: if authorized pursuant to NRS 639.2351 and subject to the limitations set forth in subsection 3, prescribe controlled substances, poisons, dangerous drugs and devices

value: Licensed Practical Nurse (LPN)
Registered Nurse (RN)
Advanced Practice Registered Nurse (APRN)
Certified Registered Nurse Anesthetist (CRNA)
license_tiers.quote: "Licensed practical nurse" means a person who is licensed to practice practical nursing as provided in this chapter. ... "Registered nurse" means a person who is licensed to practice professional nursing. ... "Advanced practice registered nurse" means a registered nurse who: 1. Has specialized skills, knowledge and experience; and 2. Is licensed by the Board to provide services in addition to those that other registered nurses are authorized to provide.

value: Advanced Practice Registered Nurse (APRN)
Certified Registered Nurse Anesthetist (CRNA)
aprn_role_categories.quote: "Advanced practice registered nurse" means a registered nurse who: 1. Has specialized skills, knowledge and experience; and 2. Is licensed by the Board to provide services in addition to those that other registered nurses are authorized to provide. ... "Certified registered nurse anesthetist" means a registered nurse who is certified by the Board pursuant to NRS 632.2395 to administer anesthetic agents to a person under the care of a licensed physician, a licensed dentist or a licensed podiatric physician.

value: registered professional nurse
advanced practice registered nurse
licensed physician
physician assistant licensed pursuant to chapter 630 or 633 of NRS
licensed dentist
licensed podiatric physician
lpn_supervision_requirements.quote: "Practice of practical nursing" means the performance of selected acts in the care of the ill, injured or infirm under the direction of a registered professional nurse, an advanced practice registered nurse, a licensed physician, a physician assistant licensed pursuant to chapter 630 or 633 of NRS, a licensed dentist or a licensed podiatric physician

full_independent_practice_available.quote: An advanced practice registered nurse may: (a) Engage in selected medical diagnosis and treatment; (b) Order home health care for a patient; (c) If authorized pursuant to NRS 639.2351 and subject to the limitations set forth in subsection 3, prescribe controlled substances, poisons, dangerous drugs and devices

prescriptive_authority_certificate_requi.quote: if authorized pursuant to NRS 639.2351 and subject to the limitations set forth in subsection 3, prescribe controlled substances, poisons, dangerous drugs and devices

value: Schedule II (with at least 2 years or 2,000 hours clinical experience, or pursuant to protocol approved by collaborating physician)
Schedule III
Schedule IV
Schedule V (implied by general controlled substance authority)
controlled_substance_schedule_authority.quote: An advanced practice registered nurse who is authorized to prescribe controlled substances, poisons, dangerous drugs and devices pursuant to NRS 639.2351 shall not prescribe a controlled substance listed in schedule II unless: (a) The advanced practice registered nurse has at least 2 years or 2,000 hours of clinical experience; or (b) The controlled substance is prescribed pursuant to a protocol approved by a collaborating physician.

opioid_prescribing_limits.value: APRNs registered to dispense controlled substances must complete at least 2 hours of training on substance use/addictive disorders and opioid prescribing per licensure period. Schedule II controlled substances may only be prescribed by APRNs with at least 2 years or 2,000 hours of clinical experience, or pursuant to a protocol approved by a collaborating physician.
opioid_prescribing_limits.quote: An advanced practice registered nurse who is authorized to prescribe controlled substances, poisons, dangerous drugs and devices pursuant to NRS 639.2351 shall not prescribe a controlled substance listed in schedule II unless: (a) The advanced practice registered nurse has at least 2 years or 2,000 hours of clinical experience; or (b) The controlled substance is prescribed pursuant to a protocol approved by a collaborating physician.

nurse_aide_registry_maintained.quote: Any person, except a nursing assistant trainee, who practices or offers to practice as a nursing assistant in this State shall submit evidence that he or she is qualified so to practice and must be certified as provided in this chapter.

medication_assistant_certification_avail.quote: "Medication aide - certified" means a nursing assistant who is certified by the Board to administer authorized medications in designated facilities.

delegation_to_unlicensed_personnel_autho.quote: "Basic nursing services" means the performance of acts designated by the Board which are within the practice of nursing under the direction of a registered nurse or a licensed practical nurse that do not require the substantial specialized skill, judgment and knowledge required of a registered nurse or licensed practical nurse.

employer_mandatory_reporting_required.quote: The following persons shall report in writing to the Executive Director of the Board any conduct of a licensee or holder of a certificate which constitutes a violation of the provisions of this chapter

rn_death_pronouncement_authorized.quote: A registered nurse who is authorized by a physician or advanced practice registered nurse pursuant to NRS 440.415 may make a pronouncement of death.

telehealth_prescribing_rules.value: An APRN may perform medical diagnosis, treatment, home health care orders, and prescribing of controlled substances by using equipment that transfers information electronically, telephonically or by fiber optics, including through telehealth, from within or outside this State or the United States.
telehealth_prescribing_rules.quote: An advanced practice registered nurse may perform the acts described in paragraphs (a), (b) and (c) of subsection 2 by using equipment that transfers information concerning the medical condition of a patient in this State electronically, telephonically or by fiber optics, including, without limitation, through telehealth, as defined in NRS 629.515, from within or outside this State or the United States.

crna_physician_supervision_model.quote: Under the supervision of a physician licensed pursuant to chapter 630 or 633 of NRS, order, prescribe, possess and administer controlled substances, poisons, dangerous drugs and devices to treat a patient under the care of a licensed physician in a critical access hospital in preparation for surgery or childbirth, during surgery or childbirth and while a patient recovers from surgery or childbirth.
